Variants.Content: Tianji City is located in the Crimson Mountains northwest of Dorne, guarding the Prince's Pass. It is the ancestral castle of the Fowler family. It belongs to Dorne, but directly faces the Reach and the March lords; no army, caravan, or envoy trying to cross the mountains through the Prince's Pass can ignore this mountain fortress.

Entry Skyreach Local families also rely on wells, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and travel to avoid the hot sun; if any road, well, or dock fails, the cost falls first on them.
Entry Skyreach They also recognize Dornish accents, laws and credentials; reputations can travel great distances from taverns, but true distances must still be measured by wheel, oar or horse's hoof.

Entry Skyreach If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.
Entry Skyreach A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Skyreach They care about wells and springs, irrigation canals, orchards, drought-tolerant livestock, and routes to avoid the scorching sun. They also look at whether seeds are left after collecting grain and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
